notes.method: lag-hardened re-sweep: 60s blackout after each speed change, then five consecutive samples within 1.0 W. Supersedes the 2026-08-13 sweep, whose table was shifted one speed to the right because the plug's Matter sensor serves the previous speed's watts for ~a minute (each old value matched the prior speed: old 8=15.4 vs true 7=15.8, old 9=20.3 vs true 8=19.7, old 0_return=44.1 vs true 12=44.2).
notes.cross_check: speeds 7 and 8 were also measured standalone with independent long dwells (15.8 W and 19.8 W) before the sweep ran; the sweep reproduced both within 0.1 W.
